list: the official 55 trophies (names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them); hidden flags per TrueTrophies; every guide written for Leonida Ledger and citing the pages its facts come from

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earned once the other 54 trophies are in. GTABase and KeenGamer put the whole run near 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. PSNProfiles lists every trophy as single player: no online trophies, no New Game+ and, per PowerPyx, no mission replay. One careful playthrough plus free-roam cleanup is enough.
steps: Work through the roadmap tab's stages in order.
Before Chapter 2, join Lucia for the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (Positive Mental Attitude).
Leave cheats alone: PowerPyx says they disable trophies and saving for that session.
trophies.when: Not missable on its own, but it needs every other trophy, the one possible missable included.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unlocks at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission (GTABase, KeenGamer). PSNProfiles shows about 97% of players with it.
steps: Play the prologue until Gone Fishing ends.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 1, though GTABase says it actually pops after What’s in the Bag?, the first Chapter 2 mission, so don't panic at the chapter card. OutputLag lists it the same way. Do Lucia's balcony meditation before you leave Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Clear the Chapter 1 missions.
After Down to Earth, meditate on the balcony with Lucia.
Play What’s in the Bag?; the trophy follows it.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 2; GTABase says it lands as Chapter 3 opens, after Welcome to Vice City. PowerPyx and OutputLag note that Chapter 2 is where side content opens up: partner switching after Coffee Break, garages after Daily Driver, Scooter Bros after Moses. Start those lines here.
steps: Clear the Chapter 2 story missions.
Play Welcome to Vice City; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 3. GTABase says it arrives after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. PowerPyx notes Chapter 3 hands out the heist tools (the Snap Gun from Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check). OutputLag calls the Race Against Yago strand time-sensitive, so finish it before you push on.
steps: Clear Chapter 3, Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs and Credit Check included.
Finish Race Against Yago while it is on offer.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 4 (GTABase, OutputLag). At the end of the chapter, PowerPyx says the optional That’s Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe) opens the large bank vaults. Those vaults feed Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together, so don't skip it.
steps: Clear the Chapter 4 story missions.
Take the optional That’s Where The Money Is... when it shows up.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for the last story mission. KeenGamer and OutputLag confirm free roam continues after the credits. GTABase says no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so there are no choices to sweat here.
steps: Make a separate save before the finale.
Finish the final mission; free roam returns for cleanup.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 story mission that LFCarry places right after What’s in the Bag?. GTABase and OutputLag list it as plain story progress; play it through.
steps: Follow the Chapter 2 story to Breakfast Run and finish it.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 story heist. GTABase lists it as unmissable: the story won't move on until you finish it.
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: GTABase lists Child's Play as a Chapter 4 story mission; it comes up as you follow the main line.
steps: Complete Child’s Play in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: GTABase lists Headliners as a Chapter 4 story mission; there is nothing extra to do.
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: GTABase lists VCIA Takedown as a Chapter 4 story mission; just play it.
steps: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A Chapter 5 story mission (GTABase). PowerPyx adds that it gives you two free garages, NE 15th Street and Pegassi Residences, which don't count toward Little Boxes.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
trophies.when: Story trophies can't be missed; they come with the main missions. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (there are 15 slots).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: PowerPyx says the 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and work done during the story counts. Required in full: all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 42 range golds, all 42 drone races (par on 28), all 15 of Bret's Target Decks and the underwater discoveries. Required in part: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animal studies (binoculars only, no killing), 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets, 30 of 40 races, 100 WAiNK spots and 100 optional missions. GTABase and games.gg agree Strangers & Freaks is not part of it.
steps: After the credits, open the checklist to see what's left.
Overshoot the activity trophies (300 stunts, 30 race wins) so both goals finish together.
Animal studies need only binoculars.
trophies.when: PowerPyx says nothing on the checklist is missable. LFCarry warns that some timed (hourglass) side jobs expire when a chapter ends, so take them when they're offered.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any mix of stunts counts toward 250. PowerPyx counts 397 in four types: stunt jumps, under-bridge passes, knife-edge flights and base jumps. Under-bridge passes add up fastest. games.gg and the PowerPyx checklist both note that 100% asks for 300, so don't stop at 250.
steps: Check your total under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Start with under-bridge passes by car or plane, the quickest type.
Go to 300 so A Long Road is covered as well.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists nine activity types to try once each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, sinking a basketball shot, an arcade game, a race or drone-race win, and a stunt. KeenGamer notes most come naturally while you chase the other activity trophies. Hunting opens through Bret only after partner switching unlocks (Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
steps: Clear the quick ones in free roam: pool, basketball, golf, arcade.
Land one stunt and win one race or drone race.
After Coffee Break, start Bret's hunting quests for the hunting entry.
trophies.when: No source flags it as missable; every activity stays open in free roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx and KeenGamer: gold on all 42 challenges across 12 shooting ranges, each range charging a $5 waiver first. The PowerPyx checklist counts the same 42 golds toward 100%, so this silver and A Long Road share the work.
steps: Visit all 12 ranges and pay the $5 waiver.
Gold every challenge; come back to the hard ones once your weapon skill is higher.
Log golds in this tracker's counter (42 in total).
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx maps 14 Top Fun sites with three races each. The trophy needs one win per site; 100% needs all 42 finished and par beaten on 28. South to north: Hamlet, Watson Bay, Capri, Buckskin Swamp, Balsero, Downtown, Dalton Island, Vice Beach, Waning Sands, Ambrosia, Port Gellhorn, Draper Island, Moreau Sawmill and Millport.
steps: Set the map filter to Activities > Top Fun Drones; a blue icon shows within about 100 m.
A taxi gets you to every site but Dalton Island, which needs a boat or aircraft.
Beat par on a site's first two races to unlock its third.
Keep the stick forward and don't clip obstacles.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: PowerPyx counts 40 distinct races, blue on the map; win 20 different ones, since repeat wins on one race don't add up. KeenGamer suggests aiming for 30 straight away, the figure the 100% checklist wants.
steps: Pick races in classes you already own fast vehicles for.
Only first places at different races count.
Keep going to 30 wins for 100%.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Cal texts you after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui and a purple fishing icon appears. Follow his fishing quests until he challenges you, then out-fish him. It also covers fishing for Master of None.
steps: Finish Feng Shui (Chapter 1) and read Cal's text.
Go to the purple fishing icon and follow his questline.
Win the fishing challenge against Cal.
trophies.when: Opens after Feng Shui in Chapter 1. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: clear every level of any one of the four in-game video games; the optional in-game challenges aren't needed. Three play on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, only on arcade cabinets around the map. The PowerPyx checklist has a line for playing all four.
steps: In Chapter 1, use the TV at home and pick a game.
Clear all its levels and ignore its side challenges.
Later, play the other three once each for the 100% checklist.
trophies.when: Doable from Chapter 1 at home. Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: GTABase and OutputLag: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 at an address in Belville. Its five missions run in order and end with Puff Puff Pass. GTABase adds that Andy, Billy and Tyrone have trophies of their own and don't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia and head to Andy's marker in Belville.
Do his five missions in order.
The last, Puff Puff Pass, unlocks the trophy.
trophies.when: GTABase says everything but Positive Mental Attitude can be done after the credits; games.gg suggests saving before each strand's finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: GTABase: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 to salvage treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Look for purple chest markers and sweep each wreck with the metal detector; progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. His final mission brings the trophy.
steps: Take Kenton's job in Chapter 1.
Dive all 7 wrecks, following the purple chest icons with the metal detector out.
Go back to him for the last mission.
trophies.when: GTABase says everything but Positive Mental Attitude can be done after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: GTABase: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Chapter 2's Coffee Break is done. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, gives the trophy.
steps: Finish Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Drive to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Do all five of Billy's jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes.
trophies.when: GTABase says everything but Positive Mental Attitude can be done after the credits.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable: Not confirmed missable, but OutputLag calls Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) time-sensitive and LFCarry says hourglass side missions expire when a chapter moves on. Finish every stranger strand in the chapter it appears.
trophies.missDeadline: During Chapter 3: finish Race Against Yago before advancing the story.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands; the game keeps count. GTABase lists Kirk, Kyle, Yago (Race Against Yago) and Pilot Pete as counting, and Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani and Eddie as not. games.gg agrees the full qualifying list isn't settled, so take every stranger you meet.
steps: Start each stranger marker as soon as it appears.
Put Race Against Yago first in Chapter 3.
Watch the in-game counter; Andy, Billy and Tyrone don't add to it.
trophies.when: Possibly limited per chapter; see the warning above.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: GTABase: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS. Bring 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City; hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting grounds.
steps: Finish Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Chapter 3).
Check Randy's list for the next car.
Search hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Deliver all 16 to his west Vice City garage.
trophies.when: GTABase says everything but Positive Mental Attitude can be done after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: GTABase and OutputLag: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Wreck the synthetic drug labs marked purple around Vice City; the last job, Shut Down the Labs, unlocks it.
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3).
As Jason, take Tyrone's jobs and destroy each purple-marked lab.
Complete Shut Down the Labs.
trophies.when: GTABase says everything but Positive Mental Attitude can be done after the credits.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable: The Jason's House balcony meditation exists only in Chapter 1. After Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the morning; follow her to the balcony and join her. PowerPyx and KeenGamer flag this as the one possible missable, though it isn't confirmed the trophy needs it.
trophies.missDeadline: Before you finish Chapter 1: join Lucia on the balcony after Down to Earth.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx maps 18 sessions over 10 spots, since a spot done as both Jason and Lucia counts twice. The spots: Jason's House (balcony), Smooth Sand (sandbar off western Capri), Swamp (dock by a lookout tower, Buckskin Swamp), Worn Stone (Emerald River at Camp Moonflower), Red Rocks (Manifest Canyon where the rails cross the highway), Water Wheel (ruined paper mill, south Moreau), Jutting Cliff (tower above a mine, Mount Kalaga park), Waterfall (northwest of Tallaloko), Seaside (rocks east of Waning Sands) and Ascent Mountain (stone circle on Mount Kalaga's summit).
steps: Chapter 1: do the balcony session with Lucia after Down to Earth, and keep a save from before Chapter 2.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), visit the other spots with both characters for the double count; a purple icon shows nearby.
Ascent Mountain appears only once all the others are done, and needs both characters.
Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; games.gg notes 100% needs 15 of 18.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 for the balcony session, the rest any time after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Part of Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which only Jason can take (PowerPyx). The first job, Veteran Hunted, gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. The line runs through 15 Target Decks, all of them on the PowerPyx 100% checklist. None of the guides we read names the unique animal yet, so clear the decks in order and it will come.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), switch to Jason and find Bret.
Do Veteran Hunted to get the SM-69.
Work through Bret's Target Decks; the unique animal hunt is one of them.
trophies.when: Bret opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Not flagged as missable; his decks are on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets (480 cards in all, per PowerPyx). Cards sit indoors on tables and walls, and outdoors in yellow wall phone boxes and toolboxes. You can't buy them and the supply is finite. Each colour variant is a separate card, and duplicates add nothing. Selling a card at a Pawn Shop keeps it in your Collections. Start with the small sets: Backyard Wrestling (12 cards) and Delights Dancers (18).
steps: Loot every phone box and toolbox you pass.
Go for Backyard Wrestling (12) and Delights Dancers (18), then one more set.
Sell duplicates at a Pawn Shop; your collection progress stays.
100% asks for 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone camera. PowerPyx and games.gg list more than enough: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Place scans are tracked apart from vehicle scans, so cars don't help here.
steps: Scan every landmark, sculpture and curiosity as you explore.
Top up with No Flusher tags.
The 100% checklist needs the same 100.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 Challenges: the trophy needs 50 and 100% needs 70, so the ten hardest can be skipped (PowerPyx, games.gg). PowerPyx and KeenGamer both leave it for late in the run, since many finish themselves while you do other things.
steps: See which Challenges are already done before chasing any.
Save the 10 toughest for last; you never need them.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with Jason and Lucia together, then shake it. PowerPyx says it counts only once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search circle. A large vault robbery gives 4 stars at once, so it often pops during That’s Where The Money Is... in Chapter 4. For an earlier try, games.gg points to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, which hides you from helicopters.
steps: Team up with your partner (after Coffee Break).
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Drive into the Ambrosia train tunnel and wait there until the heat zone clears.
trophies.when: Not flagged as missable by PowerPyx, KeenGamer or GTABase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while the red-and-blue wanted level is still live; sitting in a heat zone with no active stars breaks the chain. PowerPyx's route is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Bring armour, sticky bombs and healing. games.gg notes the unlock can lag about 30 seconds after shop three; rob a fourth if it doesn't show.
steps: Finish Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to open the jewelry route.
Rob the first store with your partner and keep the stars up.
Go straight to stores two and three without losing the wanted level.
Wait about 30 s, and hit a fourth shop if needed.
trophies.when: No source flags it as missable; shops stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with WAiNK: hold d-pad Up, then press R1 (PowerPyx). You'll reach 100 well before the 200 of 277 base models the PowerPyx checklist wants for 100%. games.gg notes special standout vehicles don't count toward that 200.
steps: Scan every new car you see in traffic.
Check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
Keep going to 200 base models for 100%.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one Combat Focus window (L3+R3 while aiming). PowerPyx recommends gang members at Illegal Operations; police, soldiers and civilians seem not to count. Fill the Focus bar first with food, drinks or a shower, and use Adrenaline to stretch it. games.gg adds that body armour and the Duke 556 rifle help.
steps: Fill Focus: eat, drink or shower.
Head to an Illegal Gang Operation with armour and an assault rifle.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop five gang members.
If Focus drains too fast, raise its level with shooting ranges, golf, pool or fishing.
trophies.when: Not flagged as missable; gang operations respawn.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner at Vice City International. games.gg says it must be one docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 are easiest); planes parked elsewhere don't count. Reach the cockpit, back off the gate, taxi to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km out. OutputLag and GTABase note the unlock is slightly delayed.
steps: At the VCIA terminal, find a jet at gate E3 or E4.
Board it, get to the cockpit and reverse out.
Take off, fly roughly 1 km away and wait for the pop.
trophies.when: Free roam; not missable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: GTABase: take a Rhino tank from the south end of Mile Zero Air Station, on the far southwest island of Mariana County, and kill enemies with it. OutputLag and KeenGamer say to keep driving and firing until it pops; the exact trigger isn't confirmed.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (southwest Mariana County).
Steal a Rhino from the south end.
Take out enemies with the tank until the trophy appears.
trophies.when: Free roam; not missable.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. PowerPyx and games.gg give the same order: pick the locked back door with it (kicking it trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code, switch off the alarm, wipe the camera footage, then open the safe quietly. Leave and the trophy follows shortly. Both suggest Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
At Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, use the Snap Gun on the back door.
Read the safe code note, disable the alarm and delete the footage.
Open the safe and walk out unseen.
trophies.when: Opens in Chapter 3. Not flagged as missable; stores stay available.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: large vaults open after the optional That’s Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe) at the end of Chapter 4. Tail a security van to a bank; while its guard carries cash in, the vault stands open briefly. Take the vault, the till and the safe, then run as soon as the 4 stars land. Rob 5 of the 8: Fleeca VCIA, Fleeca Tequesta, Lombank Downtown, Fleeca Downtown, Lombank Ocean Beach (two), Fleeca Ocean Beach and Shorefront Ocean Beach. KeenGamer and games.gg note 100% wants all 8.
steps: Do That’s Where The Money Is... at the end of Chapter 4.
Rob two Payday Loans for Yasmani so he'll sell van tips ($10,000).
Follow a van to the bank and loot vault, drawer and safe; bring your partner to carry bags.
Escape on a fast motorbike through traffic, then swap vehicles.
trophies.when: Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Any armored-truck robbery you escape counts. PowerPyx says it usually unlocks on its own during the Chapter 4 bank mission, because a vault job counts. For an earlier unlock, games.gg suggests sticky-bombing a cash truck's back doors, grabbing the bags and leaving the red heat zone (or using a Pay ’n’ Spray). The Ambrosia train tunnel works here too.
steps: Find an armored truck and stick a bomb on its rear doors.
Grab the cash and run.
Lose the heat completely: tunnel or Pay ’n’ Spray.
trophies.when: Not flagged as missable.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear all the fog from the Leonida map. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both say long sweeps in a plane are fastest; finish the last patches by car.
steps: Buy or steal a plane once you can fly.
Sweep the map edge to edge, then look for leftover fog.
trophies.when: Not flagged as missable; free roam continues after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs. PowerPyx counts 39 operations: Kingfishers (3), Kolts & Associates (5), M7 (2), La Polilla Negra (2), Final Chapter (4), San4San (5), PTT Youngin$ (2), The Guardia Brothers (3) and Other Criminals (13). Hovering the yellow icon previews the main loot, and operations respawn after a while. The PowerPyx page was still being filled in when we read it (32 of 39 mapped).
steps: Map filter: Robberies > Illegal Operations; a yellow icon appears when you're close.
Hit one operation per gang; Progress > Gangs tracks it.
Pair it with Gunslinger, since these gang members count for Combat Focus.
trophies.when: Operations respawn and are on the 100% checklist, so it isn't missable.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: GTABase and KeenGamer both list the method as unknown, and PSNProfiles has only the official text. Going by the description, it means having a drink somewhere overlooking Ocean Beach, so try the bars and rooftops there. That is our reading of the wording, not a tested step.
trophies.when: Unknown. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. GTABase, Of Zen and Computing and KeenGamer all guess the same from the wording: drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's front window. Treat it as a likely lead, not a proven route.
trophies.when: Unknown. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: GTABase and games.gg: rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, the gang operation first marked in Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take three things: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway office (Sticky Bombs needed). Then lose the police.
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs.
Take the watch (SE office) and the shotgun (NE table).
Blow the safe in the NE hallway office.
Escape the wanted level.
trophies.when: OutputLag says the operation comes back if you leave something behind, so it isn't missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. games.gg and OutputLag suggest training together at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) so both gain at once. GTABase says home training works after the story too.
steps: Find a fitness club under Map > Activities.
Train with both characters there.
Repeat until both Strength bars are full.
trophies.when: Not missable.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable: Disputed. GTABase, games.gg and OutputLag say it isn't missable; LFCarry and Of Zen and Computing warn that choices might lock it. GTABase adds that the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so stay out of it.
trophies.missDeadline: Any time: don’t let your Criminal Profile become Irredeemable.
trophies.guide: GTABase describes a hidden 0/500 counter of actions that change your Criminal Profile. games.gg says robberies and fights count, so it fills in normal play. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch it climb.
steps: Settings > UI: turn on Criminal Profile notifications.
Play normally; robberies and fights count.
Stay clear of the permanent Irredeemable profile.
trophies.when: Fills on its own; see the warning above.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: GTABase and KeenGamer list the method as unknown. The description suggests repeating something that went wrong the first time. We saw a community hint about re-robbing the prologue's Payday Loan store once you have the Dye Pack Jammer, but couldn't open that page, so it stays unverified and uncited.
trophies.when: Unknown. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: GTABase and KeenGamer say only that it's a strange event or easter egg, with no location given. Until a guide documents it, the official description is all there is: something odd you witness out in the world.
trophies.when: Unknown. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. GTABase, KeenGamer and OutputLag read it as knocking pedestrians down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; a bike drive-by is the obvious try. That's the description's meaning, not a tested route.
trophies.when: Unknown. No source flags it as missable.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a running total of $250,000 in marked bills. PowerPyx says you need the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check first. Marked cash comes from the 14 small banks, the 8 large vaults and the 7 Payday Loans, and Yasmani pays the best rate.
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3).
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Launder through Yasmani until the total passes $250,000.
trophies.when: After Credit Check. Free roam stays open after the credits, and this is on the 100% checklist, where PowerPyx says nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops overall. PowerPyx says guns, car mods and tattoos add up fastest (24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 11 tattoo studios). games.gg advises buying the $160,000 of garages first so the two trophies don't compete for cash.
steps: Buy the garages for Little Boxes first.
Then spend on weapons, armour and car mods you'll use anyway.
trophies.when: Not flagged as missable.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, $160,000 in total. They are Mitchell Auto Center ($4,000), Persistence Road ($7,600), 7th Avenue ($12,000), Store n’ Bolt ($16,800), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Vela Rota Driver ($24,000), Bonita Court ($34,000) and Atlantic Court ($40,000). The four free story garages don't count, and games.gg notes garages aren't on the 100% checklist.
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to get the real estate app.
Buy the cheap ones early; they also give you parking for On the Spot.
Save up for Bonita Court and Atlantic Court once heists pay out.
trophies.when: The app unlocks after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. Not flagged as missable.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Steal cars, bring them to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in the Scooter Bros app; do it 10 times. PowerPyx says Moses takes only tracker-free cars at first, and from Chapter 3 cars with a Standard Tracker can be registered at Pay ’n’ Sprays too. games.gg suggests cheap cars or bikes to keep costs down. You need somewhere to park them: PowerPyx counts 18 spots (16 in garages, 2 outside).
steps: Finish Moses (Chapter 2).
Steal tracker-free cars and take them to Moses.
Respray > Register each one, then store it in a garage.
trophies.when: After Moses in Chapter 2. Not flagged as missable.
